content.short: Drasil enables projects of any size to easily create and manage blockchain applications.
content.description: Drasil's modular blockchain application framework enables projects and businesses to to easily create, manage and integrate blockchain applications. The Drasil platform provides code-free access to create, manage and easily integrate applications such as token reward and distribution, token and NFT marketplaces/shops, minting, staking, vesting and other common and useful blockchain utilities.
content.meta: Find out about Drasil on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
